task_completion.description: The agent opens the Webots simulation environment and loads the soccer world.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Webots GUI with a soccer field and robot players visible.

task_completion.description: The agent modifies the WorldInfo 'basicTimeStep' to a value between 8 and 64.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree or a text editor showing 'basicTimeStep' set to a value <= 64 (e.g., 32 or 16).

task_completion.description: The agent modifies the WorldInfo 'gravity' to a realistic value (approx. 9.81).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree or a text editor showing the 'gravity' field in WorldInfo changed from 0 to a value >= 9.0.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the BLUE_PLAYER_1 robot and sets its physics mass to a value greater than 0.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Scene Tree showing the 'physics' field of BLUE_PLAYER_1 with a 'mass' value > 0.1.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the corrected simulation to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/fixed_simulation.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog box or a terminal command showing the file being saved to /home/ga/Desktop/fixed_simulation.wbt.

integrity.description: The agent uses the Webots Scene Tree or built-in editor rather than just script-based file manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots Scene Tree nodes or the internal text editor.

integrity.description: The agent enters specific numerical values rather than leaving fields blank or using variables.
integrity.visual_evidence: Actual numbers (e.g., 9.81, 32, 0.5) visible in the input fields of the Webots GUI.

integrity.description: The agent saves the file to the desktop as requested, not a temporary directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path /home/ga/Desktop/fixed_simulation.wbt visible in the file explorer or save dialog.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The simulation is broken in three specific ways: 1. basicTimeStep is set to 256 (must be <= 64 for performance/accuracy). 2. Gravity is set to 0 (must be >= 9.0). 3. BLUE_PLAYER_1 has a mass of 0 (must be > 0.1). The final file must be saved exactly to /home/ga/Desktop/fixed_simulation.wbt.
